summary: Thinking Machines offers Inkling and Inkling Small on OpenRouter at $0 prompt and completion, with a 1M-token context window. The free endpoints are restricted to agentic-harness use, not unrestricted chat. Do not send confidential information or personal data, including voices or images of people's faces. Prompts and outputs are logged and used for model training/improvement and to improve products and services; session data is disassociated from account identifiers before that use. Use constitutes agreement to the TML Free Research API terms. No hard end date is listed. The free endpoint ended on November 10, 2026: OpenRouter's API listed no provider for it.
claim_steps: Ended November 10, 2026: OpenRouter no longer serves Inkling and Inkling Small for free (no provider on the :free endpoint). The steps below describe how it was claimed.
Sign in to OpenRouter at openrouter.ai.
Configure an agentic harness with thinkingmachines/inkling:free or thinkingmachines/inkling-small:free; the free endpoints are only available for agentic-harness use.
Review the TML Free Research API terms linked on the model page. Using the endpoint agrees to logging prompts and outputs for model training/improvement and service improvement.
Never send confidential information or personal data, including voices or images of people's faces.
Send eligible harness requests within OpenRouter's free-model limits; prompt and completion prices are $0.
